prompt:
Editorial still photograph, dark and dramatic. A single sheet of matte white paper lies flat on a seamless near-black paper backdrop, slightly rotated, lit by a single narrow slice of warm light from the left that falls across the sheet; the rest of the frame falls into deep shadow.
The sheet is a company admin view for a training cohort, a seat list with a cohort start date. It shows only the artifact's own content, never a caption or description of what it is, printed in clean modern sans-serif typography, near-black ink, generous margins and a clear hierarchy. Visible text, spelled exactly: "Cohort starts Mon, Nov 2"; "Seats · 24 of 25 assigned"; "Add a seat". One small printed teal (#5BC4C4) highlight on the "Add a seat" button.
Nothing else in the frame: no hands, no people, no desk, no pens, no plants, no devices, no props, no logos. Moody, minimal, high-end print photography.
